annotation.title_clean: Florida Statutes s. 316.85 – Autonomous vehicles; operation; compliance with traffic and motor vehicle laws; testing
annotation.title_en: Florida Statutes s. 316.85 – Autonomous vehicles; operation; compliance with traffic and motor vehicle laws; testing
annotation.summary_en: Florida statute s. 316.85 permits fully autonomous vehicles to operate without a human operator, deems the automated driving system the operator, applies transportation network company and insurance rules to on-demand autonomous networks, allows teleoperation, and preempts local governments from imposing taxes, fees or other requirements on autonomous vehicles.
key_provisions_or_claims: No licensed human operator required for fully autonomous vehicles.
Automated driving system is deemed the operator when engaged.
On-demand autonomous vehicle networks follow TNC law and must meet insurance requirements in s. 627.749.
Teleoperated vehicles may operate without a human physically present, subject to s. 319.145.
State preempts local governments from taxing or regulating autonomous vehicles, with airport/seaport fee exceptions.
